ex: 她喜欢看时装杂志。
She likes reading fashion magazines.
巴黎的时装周非常有名。
Paris Fashion Week is very famous.
use: 时装表演 is a fashion show.

ex: 中国人很重视礼节。
Chinese people value etiquette highly.
见面握手是一种基本礼节。
Shaking hands when you meet is basic etiquette.
use: Close to 礼貌, but about set customs.

m: **Agree** to watch **according to** need: **to look after**.
ex: 出门在外，互相照应。
When away from home, look after each other.
我第一次来，请你多照应。
It's my first time here, so please keep an eye on me.

m: Trust like a **letter** and **praise**: a **good reputation**.
ex: 这家公司信誉很好。
This company has a good reputation.
做生意最重要的是信誉。
In business, reputation is what matters most.
新市长今天就职。
The new mayor takes office today.
他在一家银行就职。
He works at a bank.

m: **Love** and **cherish**: **to treasure**, to use with care.
ex: 我们要爱惜粮食。
We should not waste food.
他很爱惜自己的书，从不弄脏。
He takes great care of his books and never gets them dirty.
use: For things, time, health: use them carefully.

ex: 衷心感谢您的帮助。
My heartfelt thanks for your help.
我衷心希望你能成功。
I sincerely hope you succeed.
use: Formal; before 感谢, 希望, 祝愿.

m: **Ask** the **guests**: **to treat**, to pay for others.
ex: 今天我请客。
Today it's my treat.
他升职了，说要请客吃饭。
He got promoted and says he'll treat us to a meal.
use: Means paying the bill for friends.

ex: 大家踊跃发言。
Everyone eagerly spoke up.
欢迎同学们踊跃参加比赛。
Students are warmly encouraged to take part in the contest.
use: Often 踊跃参加, 踊跃报名.

ex: 新的手机层出不穷。
New phones keep appearing one after another.
网上的骗局层出不穷，大家要小心。
Online scams keep popping up; everyone should be careful.
use: For new things or problems that keep appearing.

ex: 他年轻时在外面流浪了几年。
When young, he drifted around for a few years.
路边有一只流浪猫。
There's a stray cat by the road.
use: 流浪狗, stray dog; 流浪汉, a tramp.

m: **Join** together for **meals** and work: **to go into partnership**.
ex: 我们合伙开了一家店。
We opened a shop together as partners.
他跟朋友合伙做生意。
He went into business with a friend.
她是个坚韧的女人。
She is a resilient woman.
这种绳子非常坚韧。
This rope is very tough.

m: **Long for** it so much you can **not** **get** enough: **to be eager to**.
ex: 我巴不得马上放假。
I can't wait for the holidays to start.
他巴不得你早点走呢。
He'd love for you to leave early.
use: Spoken; followed by a verb or clause.

ex: 他每周都买彩票。
He buys a lottery ticket every week.
听说他中了彩票，得了一百万。
I heard he won a million on the lottery.
use: 中彩票, to win the lottery.

ex: 孩子发烧了。
The child has a fever.
我昨天发烧，没去上班。
I had a fever yesterday and didn't go to work.
use: 发高烧, a high fever; 发烧友, a fan or buff.

ex: 他为人谦逊。
He is a humble person.
这位科学家非常谦逊，从不炫耀。
This scientist is very humble and never shows off.
他被警察拘留了。
He was detained by the police.
那个司机因为酒后开车被拘留了十天。
The driver was held for ten days for drink-driving.
打个比方，你就明白了。
Let me give you an analogy, and you'll understand.
比方说，你可以先学简单的字。
For example, you can learn the simple characters first.
总而言之，我们要努力。
In short, we must work hard.
总而言之，这次旅行很成功。
All in all, this trip was a success.
use: Starts a summary; 总之 is shorter.

m: **Understand** and **untie** the problem: **to forgive**, to understand.
ex: 请你谅解。
Please understand.
我们得到了大家的谅解。
We received everyone's understanding.
use: Polite; often 请谅解 or 互相谅解.

m: The **gown** of the **banner** people: a **qipao**, cheongsam.
ex: 她穿了一件旗袍。
She's wearing a qipao.
旗袍是中国传统服装。
The qipao is a traditional Chinese dress.
他太自私了。
He is too selfish.
别那么自私，也想想别人。
Don't be so selfish; think of others too.
他从小能吃苦。
He's been able to endure hardship since he was little.
年轻人应该吃苦，才能成长。
Young people should face hardship in order to grow.
use: 吃苦耐劳, hardworking and tough.

ex: 警察救出了人质。
The police rescued the hostages.
那个人抓了三个人质。
That man took three hostages.
use: Measure word 名 or 个.

m: **Think** of every **way** and **set up** every **method**: **to try every means**.
ex: 他想方设法帮助我。
He tried every way to help me.
妈妈想方设法让孩子多吃蔬菜。
Mum does everything she can to get her child to eat more vegetables.

m: Every **home** **describes** it and every **household** **knows** it: **a household name**.
ex: 这个故事家喻户晓。
Everyone knows this story.
他是一位家喻户晓的演员。
He is a household-name actor.
今天的晚饭很丰盛。
Tonight's dinner is a real feast.
过年时，家家都准备了丰盛的饭菜。
At New Year, every family prepares a big feast.
我查了一下字典。
I looked it up in the dictionary.
这本字典对学中文很有帮助。
This dictionary is very helpful for learning Chinese.
use: Measure word 本; 词典 lists words, 字典 characters.

ex: 爷爷每天听收音机。
Grandpa listens to the radio every day.
这台收音机已经用了二十年。
This radio has been in use for twenty years.

m: A paper that **protects** you, **according to** law: a **passport**.
ex: 别忘了带护照。
Don't forget your passport.
我的护照下个月就过期了。
My passport expires next month.
我在阳台上种了花。
I planted flowers on the balcony.
天气好的时候，我喜欢在阳台上看书。
When the weather is nice, I like reading on the balcony.

m: Tossed head over **top** like grain being **winnowed**: **to be jolted**.
ex: 路不好，车很颠簸。
The road is bad, so the car bumps a lot.
飞机颠簸得很厉害，大家都很紧张。
The plane shook badly, and everyone was nervous.
use: For bumpy rides in cars, boats and planes.

ex: 附近有一家饭馆。
There's a restaurant nearby.
我们去饭馆吃吧，不做饭了。
Let's eat at a restaurant instead of cooking.
use: Measure word 家; plainer than 饭店 or 餐厅.

ex: 她有一头乌黑的头发。
She has jet-black hair.
天上乌黑一片，快下雨了。
The sky has gone pitch-black; it's about to rain.
熊猫爱吃竹子。
Pandas love eating bamboo.
这把椅子是竹子做的。
This chair is made of bamboo.
use: Measure word 根 or 棵.

ex: 请先阅读考试须知。
Please read the exam instructions first.
入住须知贴在门后。
The check-in notes are posted on the back of the door.
use: Often on signs: 乘客须知, 游客须知.

ex: 他是一个冷酷的人。
He is a cold-hearted person.
现实有时候很冷酷。
Reality can sometimes be harsh.
我周末去姥姥家。
I'm going to Grandma's at the weekend.
姥姥做的饺子最好吃。
Grandma's dumplings are the best.

m: At **ease** and **not** **forced** or hurried: **calm and unhurried**.
ex: 他从容不迫地回答问题。
He answered the questions calmly.
面对困难，她总是从容不迫。
She always stays composed in the face of difficulty.
use: Often before a verb with 地.

ex: 她今天穿得很性感。
She's dressed very sexily today.
他的声音很性感。
He has a sexy voice.

m: **Bow** for the **New Year**: **to pay a New Year visit**.
ex: 我们去给爷爷拜年。
We're going to wish Grandpa a happy New Year.
春节时，大家互相拜年。
At Spring Festival, everyone exchanges New Year greetings.
这孩子将来一定有出息。
This child will certainly do well in life.
你怎么这么没出息？
How can you be so useless?
use: 有出息, promising; 没出息, good-for-nothing.

ex: 这是一个有名的寓言。
This is a famous fable.
寓言故事常常告诉我们一个道理。
Fables often teach us a lesson.
use: Measure word 个 or 则.

ex: 请不要践踏草地。
Please keep off the grass.
这种做法践踏了人的尊严。
This kind of action tramples on human dignity.
use: Formal; also figurative for rights and laws.

ex: 她性格很开朗。
She has a cheerful personality.
他是个开朗的人，朋友很多。
He's an outgoing person with lots of friends.
use: For personality; also for a wide view.

ex: 他在家里休养。
He's recuperating at home.
医生让她休养一个月。
The doctor told her to rest for a month.
use: Close to 休息, but longer and for recovery.

ex: 这件事让我很恼火。
This thing really annoys me.
他迟到了好几次，老板很恼火。
He's been late several times, and the boss is irritated.
use: Spoken; between 生气 and 愤怒.

m: There is **no** **connection** to worry about: **it doesn't matter**.
ex: “对不起。”“没关系。”
"Sorry." "That's all right."
没关系，我们明天再去。
It doesn't matter; we'll go tomorrow.
use: The standard reply to 对不起.

m: Keep the **essence** and make it **simple**: **to streamline**.
ex: 公司要精简人员。
The company is going to cut staff.
请把这篇文章精简一下。
Please trim this article down a bit.
这是一个英明的决定。
This is a wise decision.
大家都说老板很英明。
Everyone says the boss is very wise.
use: Praise for leaders and decisions; can be ironic.

ex: 贵的东西不见得好。
Expensive things aren't necessarily good.
他说会来，可是不见得会来。
He said he would come, but he may not.
哎哟，好疼！
Ouch, that hurts!
哎哟，我忘了带钥匙！
Oh no, I forgot my keys!
use: An exclamation of pain, surprise or annoyance.

ex: 把药膏涂抹在伤口上。
Apply the ointment to the wound.
墙上被孩子涂抹得乱七八糟。
The kids scribbled all over the wall.
use: Written; spoken is 抹 or 涂.

ex: 他吃东西很挑剔。
He's very fussy about food.
她总是挑剔别人的毛病。
She's always finding fault with others.
这是我的过失。
This is my fault.
由于他的过失，公司损失了很多钱。
Due to his mistake, the company lost a lot of money.
过年的时候放鞭炮。
At New Year people set off firecrackers.
很多城市已经不让放鞭炮了。
Many cities no longer allow firecrackers.
他壮烈地牺牲了。
He died a hero's death.
这是一个壮烈的故事。
This is a heroic and stirring story.
做生意需要本钱。
You need capital to do business.
身体是工作的本钱。
Your health is your capital for work.
use: Also figurative: what you have to rely on.

m: What the **heart** has **gained**: **insights**, what one has learned.
ex: 请谈谈你的学习心得。
Please share what you have learned.
读完这本书，我写了一篇心得。
After reading this book, I wrote up my thoughts.
use: Often 学习心得, 读书心得.

ex: 他的知识很贫乏。
His knowledge is very limited.
这个地区资源贫乏。
This area is poor in resources.
通货膨胀让物价上涨了。
Inflation has made prices go up.
这个国家的通货是什么？
What is this country's currency?
use: Mostly in 通货膨胀, inflation.

ex: 我们去看杂技表演吧。
Let's go and see an acrobatics show.
中国杂技在世界上很有名。
Chinese acrobatics are famous around the world.
我们每天要摄取足够的营养。
We need to take in enough nutrients every day.
少摄取糖对身体有好处。
Taking in less sugar is good for your health.
公园里有一个亭子。
There's a pavilion in the park.
下雨了，我们去亭子里避雨吧。
It's raining; let's shelter in the pavilion.
use: Measure word 座 or 个.

m: **Report** and **melt away** the cost: **to claim expenses**.
ex: 出差的费用可以报销。
Business trip costs can be claimed back.
这张发票不能报销。
This receipt can't be reimbursed.
她很害羞，不爱说话。
She is very shy and doesn't like to talk.
别害羞，大声说出来。
Don't be shy; say it out loud.
祝您生意兴隆！
May your business prosper!
这家店生意一直很兴隆。
This shop's business has always been brisk.
use: Mostly in 生意兴隆, a common greeting.

ex: 我们姑且试一试。
Let's give it a try for now.
这个问题姑且不谈。
Let's set this question aside for now.
天冷了，戴上手套吧。
It's cold now; put on your gloves.
我的手套丢了一只。
I've lost one of my gloves.
use: Measure word 双 for a pair, 只 for one.

ex: 他们在森林里迷失了方向。
They lost their way in the forest.
在大城市里，很多年轻人迷失了自己。
In the big city, many young people lose themselves.
use: Often 迷失方向, to get lost.

ex: 我的鼠标没电了。
My mouse has run out of battery.
用鼠标点一下这个按钮。
Click this button with the mouse.

m: The **article** of how you **walk** in life: **conduct**.
ex: 这个学生品行很好。
This student is of good character.
找工作时，品行也很重要。
When looking for work, character also matters.

m: Go to what is **near**: **nearby**, at a place close at hand.
ex: 你可以就近找个医院。
You can find a hospital nearby.
孩子们一般就近上学。
Children usually go to a school near home.
我明天想请假。
I'd like to take tomorrow off.
他生病了，向老师请假。
He's ill and asked the teacher for leave.
use: Pattern: 向……请假; 请病假, sick leave.

m: **Much** is owed and you'd have **lost** without it: **thanks to**.
ex: 多亏你帮我。
Thank goodness you helped me.
多亏了医生，他的病好了。
Thanks to the doctor, he recovered.
use: Followed by the helper; shows relief.

ex: 他的心胸太狭隘了。
He's too narrow-minded.
不要用狭隘的眼光看问题。
Don't look at problems in a narrow way.
use: Mostly figurative for minds and views.

ex: 他做事太急躁了。
He's too hasty in how he does things.
别急躁，慢慢来。
Don't be impatient; take it slowly.
use: Character trait; close to 着急.

ex: 这份文件需要公证。
This document needs to be notarized.
我们去公证处办手续。
We're going to the notary office to do the paperwork.

m: **Long for** favours and tie a **knot** to the boss: **to suck up to**.
ex: 他总是巴结领导。
He's always sucking up to the leaders.
我不喜欢巴结别人。
I don't like flattering people.
请准时到。
Please arrive on time.
火车准时出发了。
The train left on time.
use: Opposite: 迟到 or 晚点.

ex: 这是社会上丑恶的现象。
This is an ugly side of society.
他终于看清了那个人丑恶的嘴脸。
He finally saw that person's true ugly face.
那是一个愚昧的时代。
That was an age of ignorance.
我们要用科学战胜愚昧。
We must defeat ignorance with science.
use: Formal; for societies and old beliefs.

ex: 学外语需要毅力。
Learning a foreign language takes perseverance.
他靠毅力完成了比赛。
He finished the race through sheer willpower.

m: **Strive** with your **spirit**: **to do one well**, to live up to hopes.
ex: 这孩子真争气，考上了大学。
This kid has done us proud and got into university.
你要争气，别让父母失望。
You must try hard and not let your parents down.

m: Turn to **dregs** and **step on** them: **to waste**, **to ruin**.
ex: 别糟蹋粮食。
Don't waste food.
这么好的东西，被他糟蹋了。
Such a good thing, and he ruined it.
不要虐待动物。
Don't mistreat animals.
他因为虐待孩子被抓了。
He was arrested for abusing a child.
外面的噪音太大了。
The noise outside is too loud.
长时间听噪音对耳朵不好。
Listening to noise for long periods is bad for your ears.
他是一个孝顺的儿子。
He is a devoted son.
我们要孝顺父母。
We should be good to our parents.
他说话很斯文。
He speaks in a very refined way.
这个男孩看起来很斯文。
This boy looks very gentle and well-mannered.
这本书引起了读者的共鸣。
This book struck a chord with readers.
他的话让我产生了共鸣。
His words resonated with me.

m: **Divide** up the **red**, lucky profits: **to pay a dividend**.
ex: 公司年底给员工分红。
The company pays staff a bonus at year's end.
今年的分红比去年多。
This year's dividend is higher than last year's.

m: Treat as one's **duty** and find it **odd**: **to blame**.
ex: 别责怪自己。
Don't blame yourself.
妈妈没有责怪我，反而安慰了我。
Mum didn't blame me; instead she comforted me.
我坦白告诉你吧。
Let me be frank with you.
他向警察坦白了一切。
He confessed everything to the police.

m: Talk about **cold** and **warm** weather: **to exchange pleasantries**.
ex: 他们寒暄了几句。
They exchanged a few pleasantries.
寒暄过后，我们开始谈工作。
After the small talk, we began to discuss work.
他玩弄了她的感情。
He toyed with her feelings.
别玩弄小聪明。
Don't play clever tricks.
use: Usually negative: 玩弄感情, 玩弄手段.

ex: 那个山村交通闭塞。
That mountain village has poor transport links.
他住的地方很闭塞，消息很少。
Where he lives is cut off, and little news gets through.
use: For remote places and closed minds.

ex: 这件衣服还能凑合穿。
This piece of clothing can still do.
没有好的，就凑合一下吧。
There's nothing good, so let's make do.
你怎么这么狠心？
How can you be so heartless?
她狠心离开了家。
She steeled herself and left home.
use: Also means to make a hard decision.

ex: 请把窗帘拉上。
Please draw the curtains.
早上我打开窗帘，阳光照了进来。
In the morning I opened the curtains and sunlight came in.
use: Goes with 拉上 and 拉开.

ex: 请大家向中间靠拢。
Everyone, please move closer to the middle.
他们慢慢向我靠拢过来。
They slowly drew closer to me.

m: **Defend** what is **heavy** and precious, your health: **to take care of oneself**.
ex: 你多保重！
Take good care of yourself!
天冷了，请保重身体。
It's getting cold; please look after your health.
use: Said at partings or to the sick.

ex: 他的手被捆绑起来了。
His hands were tied up.
别把这两件事捆绑在一起。
Don't tie these two things together.
use: Also figurative: 捆绑销售, bundled sales.

ex: 请说说这篇课文的大意。
Please give the gist of this text.
我听懂了他说话的大意。
I understood the general idea of what he said.
use: Read dàyi, it means careless: 粗心大意.

ex: 这个孩子很机灵。
This child is very clever.
小狗很机灵，一叫就来。
The puppy is smart; it comes as soon as you call.
她的英语很流利。
Her English is very fluent.
他能说一口流利的汉语。
He speaks fluent Chinese.
他胸怀宽广。
He is broad-minded.
我们要有开阔的胸怀。
We should have an open mind.
use: Figurative; also a verb: 胸怀大志.

ex: 我把这件事写进了备忘录。
I wrote this down in my memo.
两国签订了合作备忘录。
The two countries signed a memorandum of cooperation.
use: Also the notes app on a phone.

m: Weigh with **authority** and a **balance**: **to weigh up**.
ex: 他权衡了利弊，决定留下。
He weighed the pros and cons and decided to stay.
这件事你要好好权衡一下。
You need to weigh this up carefully.
一个人在国外很孤单。
Being abroad on your own is lonely.
有了小狗，奶奶不再孤单了。
With the puppy, Grandma isn't lonely any more.
use: Close to 孤独; 孤单 is more about being alone.

ex: 我们学校有排球队。
Our school has a volleyball team.
下午我们去打排球吧。
Let's play volleyball this afternoon.
他的呼吸很短促。
His breathing is short and quick.
人生短促，要珍惜时间。
Life is short; treasure your time.
孩子们兴致勃勃地看表演。
The children watched the show with great interest.
他兴致勃勃地给我们讲他的旅行。
He eagerly told us about his trip.

m: One who **cuts out** cloth and **sews seams**: a **tailor**.
ex: 我请裁缝做了一件衣服。
I had a tailor make me some clothes.
她妈妈是个裁缝。
Her mother is a dressmaker.
他理直气壮地说：“不是我。”
He said boldly, "It wasn't me."
你做错了，还这么理直气壮？
You did wrong, and you're still so self-assured?
use: Can be ironic for someone wrong.

ex: 他蔑视地看了我一眼。
He gave me a scornful look.
我们不应该蔑视任何人。
We shouldn't look down on anyone.
他说话很豪迈。
He speaks in a bold, heroic way.
他们唱着豪迈的歌向前走。
They marched forward singing a rousing song.
健康的重要性不言而喻。
The importance of health goes without saying.
他的意思不言而喻。
His meaning is obvious.
他是一位廉洁的官员。
He is an honest official.
政府要廉洁，人民才会信任。
Government must be clean for the people to trust it.
我很留恋大学生活。
I really miss university life.
假期结束了，孩子们还留恋着海边。
The holiday is over, but the children still don't want to leave the seaside.
他们之间有真挚的友谊。
They share a sincere friendship.
谢谢你真挚的祝福。
Thank you for your sincere good wishes.
他太霸道了。
He's too domineering.
你不能这么霸道，别人也有权利说话。
You can't be so bossy; others have a right to speak too.
书架上有很多书。
There are lots of books on the bookshelf.
请把这本书放回书架。
Please put this book back on the shelf.

m: A **tube** to **take care of** flow: a **pipe**, **tube**.
ex: 这根管子漏水了。
This pipe is leaking.
他用管子给花浇水。
He waters the flowers with a hose.
use: Measure word 根; also the name of an ancient book.

ex: 我们会一如既往地支持你。
We'll support you as always.
他一如既往地早起跑步。
As usual, he got up early to go running.
use: Formal; before a verb with 地.

m: **Lift** a **foot** and the scale goes **light** or **heavy**: **highly influential**.
ex: 他在公司里举足轻重。
He carries a lot of weight in the company.
这是一个举足轻重的决定。
This is a decision of great importance.
他做事很有气魄。
He does things boldly.
这座大桥的设计很有气魄。
The design of this bridge is grand and imposing.
她很会交际。
She's very sociable.
交际能力在工作中很重要。
Social skills are important at work.

m: **Cross** over and **ask**: **to take an interest in**, to get involved.
ex: 这件事你别过问了。
Don't concern yourself with this.
领导亲自过问了这个案子。
The leader personally looked into this case.
菜里再放一点酱油。
Put a little more soy sauce in the dish.
我去楼下买瓶酱油。
I'm going downstairs to buy a bottle of soy sauce.
你应该去看内科。
You should see the internal medicine department.
她是内科医生。
She's a physician in internal medicine.
他是一个仁慈的老人。
He is a kind old man.
请你仁慈一点，放过它吧。
Please be merciful and let it go.
考试不能作弊。
You can't cheat in exams.
他因为作弊被抓住了。
He was caught cheating.
你养宠物吗？
Do you have a pet?
她的宠物是一只小白狗。
Her pet is a little white dog.
use: 养宠物, to keep a pet.

ex: 洗衣机坏了。
The washing machine is broken.
把脏衣服放进洗衣机吧。
Put the dirty clothes in the washing machine.
她从小受到音乐的熏陶。
She grew up steeped in music.
在父母的熏陶下，他也爱上了读书。
Under his parents' influence, he also came to love reading.
请把话筒给我。
Please pass me the microphone.
他拿起话筒开始唱歌。
He picked up the mic and started singing.
use: Also the receiver of a phone.

ex: 我饿了，想吃饼干。
I'm hungry; I'd like some biscuits.
这盒饼干是巧克力味的。
This box of biscuits is chocolate flavour.
use: Measure word 块 or 包.

ex: 他因为诈骗被抓了。
He was arrested for fraud.
接到诈骗电话，千万别给钱。
If you get a scam call, don't send any money.
我喜欢吃凉拌黄瓜。
I like cucumber salad.
妈妈在菜市场买了两根黄瓜。
Mum bought two cucumbers at the market.
use: Measure word 根 or 条.

ex: 爷爷每天早上打太极拳。
Grandpa does tai chi every morning.
公园里有很多人在练太极拳。
Lots of people are practising tai chi in the park.
use: Goes with 打 or 练.

ex: 你的推论不对。
Your inference is wrong.
从这些事实可以推论出他没说谎。
From these facts we can infer that he didn't lie.
我去邮局寄信。
I'm going to the post office to send a letter.
邮局几点关门？
What time does the post office close?
他学习的劲头很大。
He's very keen on studying.
年轻人干活有劲头。
Young people work with energy.
use: Spoken; 劲头十足, full of energy.

ex: 你歪曲了我的意思。
You twisted my meaning.
这篇报道歪曲了事实。
This report distorts the facts.

m: Running to the **barn** in a **short** time: **hurried**.
ex: 时间太仓促了。
Time is too short.
他仓促地离开了家。
He left home in a hurry.
别吹牛了！
Stop bragging!
他总爱吹牛，说自己认识很多名人。
He loves to boast that he knows lots of famous people.
use: Spoken; 吹牛皮 is the long form.

ex: 菜的味道恰到好处。
The dish is seasoned just right.
她的打扮恰到好处。
Her outfit is just perfect.

m: With **all** **power**, **using** it all to **go**: **to go all out**.
ex: 我们会全力以赴。
We will go all out.
为了这次比赛，队员们全力以赴。
The players gave it everything for this match.
这个问题他轻而易举地解决了。
He solved this problem with ease.
赢这场比赛不是轻而易举的事。
Winning this match is no easy thing.
我恰巧也在那儿。
I happened to be there too.
那天恰巧下雨，我们没出去。
It happened to rain that day, so we didn't go out.
use: Close to 正好 and 碰巧.

ex: 这样做不合情理。
Doing it this way isn't reasonable.
他生气是在情理之中的。
It's understandable that he's angry.

m: **Lift** the **head rope** of the net and all follows: an **outline**.
ex: 写文章前先写提纲。
Write an outline before writing an essay.
老师给了我们一份复习提纲。
The teacher gave us a revision outline.
我只记得一些片断。
I only remember a few fragments.
他给我们看了电影的几个片断。
He showed us a few clips from the film.

m: A **descendant** of **China**: a **person of Chinese descent**.
ex: 他是美籍华裔。
He's a Chinese American.
很多华裔孩子周末学中文。
Many children of Chinese descent study Chinese at weekends.
use: For foreign citizens of Chinese ancestry.

ex: 他斩钉截铁地说：“不行！”
He said flatly, "No way!"
她的回答斩钉截铁，没有商量的余地。
Her answer was decisive, with no room for discussion.
这本书太枯燥了。
This book is too dull.
每天做同样的工作很枯燥。
Doing the same work every day is tedious.
use: 枯燥无味, dull and tasteless.

ex: 大雪让很多旅客滞留在机场。
Heavy snow left many travellers stranded at the airport.
他在国外滞留了三个月。
He was stuck abroad for three months.
use: For people kept somewhere against their plans.

ex: 他说话很粗鲁。
He speaks very rudely.
别对服务员那么粗鲁。
Don't be so rude to the waiter.

m: **Rise** up in **roars of laughter**: **to jeer**, **to make a fuss**.
ex: 大家都在起哄。
Everyone was jeering.
别起哄了，让他说完。
Stop heckling; let him finish.
use: Also playful teasing at weddings or parties.

m: **Make** yourself the **owner**: **to decide**, to have the final say.
ex: 这件事由你做主。
You decide on this matter.
你自己做主吧。
You decide for yourself.
use: Pattern: 为……做主, to stand up for someone.

ex: 院子里的草长得很茂盛。
The grass in the yard is growing thickly.
夏天，树叶茂盛。
In summer, the trees are full of leaves.

m: A **chief** skill for a **particular** field: a **specialty**.
ex: 你的专长是什么？
What's your speciality?
他的专长是电脑。
His area of expertise is computers.
请填一下这张表格。
Please fill in this form.
我做了一个表格，列出了所有的数据。
I made a table listing all the data.
use: Measure word 张 or 份; 填表格, fill in a form.

ex: 他做事很有魄力。
He acts with real drive.
新校长很有魄力，改变了很多事情。
The new headteacher is bold and has changed a lot of things.
他把钱都挥霍光了。
He squandered all his money.
别挥霍你的青春。
Don't waste your youth.
今天的天气很沉闷。
The weather today is close and oppressive.
会议的气氛很沉闷。
The atmosphere at the meeting was heavy.
冬天我们去滑冰。
In winter we go skating.
她滑冰滑得很好。
She skates very well.
use: 滑冰场, ice rink; 滑雪, to ski.

ex: 病人终于苏醒了。
The patient finally came round.
春天到了，大地苏醒了。
Spring has come and the earth has woken up.
他因为个子矮很自卑。
He feels inferior because he's short.
不要自卑，你有很多优点。
Don't put yourself down; you have many strengths.

m: **Look** at as an **enemy**: **to be hostile to**.
ex: 他们互相敌视。
They are hostile towards each other.
不要敌视和你意见不同的人。
Don't be hostile to people who disagree with you.
真丢人！
How embarrassing!
你别在这儿丢人了。
Stop embarrassing yourself here.
这个小房子很别致。
This little house is very charming.
她的耳环设计得很别致。
Her earrings have an unusual design.
我要一杯果汁。
I'd like a glass of juice.
早上喝杯果汁对身体好。
A glass of juice in the morning is good for you.
use: Measure word 杯 or 瓶.

ex: 他一说起足球就滔滔不绝。
When he starts talking about football, he never stops.
她滔滔不绝地讲了一个小时。
She talked non-stop for an hour.
use: Before or after a verb of speaking.

ex: 我想吃西红柿炒鸡蛋。
I want stir-fried tomato and egg.
这些西红柿很新鲜。
These tomatoes are very fresh.

m: **Ask** back, **contrary** to the question: **to ask in reply**.
ex: 他没回答，反问了我一句。
He didn't answer; he asked me a question back.
“你说呢？”她反问道。
"What do you think?" she asked in return.
他们攀登了那座高山。
They climbed that high mountain.
在科学的路上，我们要不断攀登。
On the road of science, we must keep climbing higher.
这条河已经枯竭了。
This river has dried up.
地球上的石油总有一天会枯竭。
One day the Earth's oil will run out.

m: A **chain** for the **back of the neck**: a **necklace**.
ex: 她戴着一条金项链。
She's wearing a gold necklace.
这条项链是妈妈送给我的。
My mother gave me this necklace.
这件衣服打折吗？
Is this piece of clothing discounted?
商场周末打折，人特别多。
The mall has a sale this weekend, so it's very crowded.
use: 打八折 means 20% off: you pay 80%.

ex: 这瓶牛奶过期了。
This bottle of milk is past its date.
我的护照快过期了。
My passport is about to expire.
中秋节是家人团圆的日子。
Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for families to get together.
过年的时候，全家人团圆在一起。
At New Year the whole family is reunited.
这孩子很有志气。
This child has real ambition.
人穷志不穷，要有志气。
Even if poor, keep your spirit and ambition.
use: 有志气, determined to do well.

m: **Love** and **wear** someone on your head: **to love and respect**.
ex: 这位老师深受学生爱戴。
This teacher is deeply loved by students.
他是一位受人爱戴的领导。
He is a much-loved leader.
你说得对，我服气了。
You're right; I accept that.
输了比赛，他心里不服气。
He lost the match but wouldn't accept it.
use: Usually 不服气, unwilling to accept.

ex: 我有几个硬币。
I have a few coins.
这台机器只收硬币。
This machine only takes coins.
use: Measure word 个 or 枚.

m: **Ask** a **price** and **still** give a **price** back: **to haggle**.
ex: 在市场买东西可以讨价还价。
At the market you can bargain.
别跟我讨价还价了，就这样吧。
Stop haggling with me; let's settle it like this.
他每天早上练气功。
He practises qigong every morning.
有人说气功对身体有好处。
Some say qigong is good for your health.
小心小偷！
Watch out for thieves!
我的钱包被小偷偷了。
My wallet was stolen by a thief.
明天照常上课。
Classes go ahead as usual tomorrow.
虽然下雨了，比赛还是照常进行。
Although it rained, the match went ahead as normal.
请简要地说明一下。
Please explain briefly.
这是会议的简要内容。
This is a summary of the meeting.
我可以用支票付款吗？
Can I pay by cheque?
他开了一张支票给我。
He wrote me a cheque.
use: Measure word 张; 开支票, to write a cheque.

m: **Tie** someone up and carry them on a **frame**: **to kidnap**.
ex: 那个孩子被绑架了。
That child was kidnapped.
警察抓到了绑架他的人。
The police caught the people who kidnapped him.
你会下象棋吗？
Can you play Chinese chess?
爷爷常常和邻居下象棋。
Grandpa often plays Chinese chess with the neighbours.
use: Goes with 下; 国际象棋 is Western chess.

m: At the most it's **big**, but **not** the **end**: **at worst**.
ex: 大不了重新来。
At worst we'll start again.
这没什么大不了的。
It's no big deal.
use: 没什么大不了 means no big deal.

ex: 请把这份文件复印一下。
Please photocopy this document.
我要复印三份。
I need three copies.
今天天气晴朗。
It's clear and sunny today.
晴朗的夜空中有很多星星。
There are many stars in the clear night sky.
借我一把尺子。
Lend me a ruler.
用尺子量一下这张桌子有多长。
Use a ruler to measure how long this table is.
奶奶的笑容很慈祥。
Grandma has a kind smile.
一位慈祥的老人给我指了路。
A kindly old man showed me the way.
use: For older people's faces and manners.
